items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: He was completely Greg. ... He was Gregory Herbert. And this is a thing I really demand in great players.

ctx.x: I know that when he -- with the soloing on something that came from a particular period, that you could see that he was carrying on the tradition but he was still Greg.
Yeah. Then he moved to something else that was contemporary, he was still Greg.
